names.ru: Море Скорбного Плача об Усмирении Демонов

summary.text: A forbidden sea area in Paradise Earth's dragon whale paradise where a sealed demon's cries of regret sound without end.

claims.text: In the paradise it is a forbidden sea area people call Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea. In legend, after Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable turned the grotto-heaven into a paradise, he suppressed a supreme demon there and set up a super immortal formation to make him regret and repent, so the demon’s cries of regret can be heard in the sea area all the time.

Fang Yuan’s focus falls completely on Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea after wisdom path deduction. About twenty days before the saintess competition, a mission brings him as close as he has ever gotten, but thirty li from the island he cannot move closer. Paradise Earth’s arrangements are too powerful for him to act freely there.
Every time a new saintess is elected, her main mission is to enter Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea and use singing to soothe the killing intent of the demon and stabilize the sea area.

Among sea areas controlled by the Sacred Court, Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea is an absolute forbidden area. According to legends, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable suppressed a peerless demonic Gu Immortal there. Too benevolent to take the demon’s life, he sealed the demonic Gu Immortal to make him repent, so crying sounds often rise from the sea. The demon’s nature remains strong, and demonic aura accumulates over time, making living organisms stronger, ferocious, and crueler, and the aura can infect and expand the sea’s area.

Every selected saintess must go to the center of Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea and sing for three days and three nights to eliminate the increasingly dense demonic aura. The task is extremely dangerous with a very low survival rate; many saintesses die there, and some who return alive turn crazy.

Saintess Xia Lin advances toward Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea on a giant tortoise. Nearer the sea, a gale carries crying sounds of regret at having provoked Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, growing louder and more concentrated. Fang Yuan activates investigative methods until a demon suppression regret crying formation gradually appears in his mind.
